Must EW2110-2000 2000VA Line Interactive Offline UPS 

The Must EW2110-2000 2000VA Line Interactive Offline UPS is a high-performance backup power solution designed for homes, offices, and small IT setups that require reliable protection against power outages, voltage fluctuations, and electrical disturbances. This UPS ensures uninterrupted power for PCs, routers, CCTV systems, POS machines, and other sensitive electronics, preventing data loss and equipment damage. With its advanced line-interactive design, the EW2110-2000 delivers stable output voltage, fast switching time, and extended backup performance—making it ideal for Bangladesh’s frequent voltage drops and load-shedding conditions. Its compact design, silent operation, and maintenance-free battery system make it a dependable power protection choice for everyday use.


Key Features

  • Power Capacity: 2000VA / 1200W
  • Line Interactive Technology for enhanced voltage stability
  • Automatic Voltage Regulation (AVR) protects devices from high and low voltage
  • High-quality built-in batteries for long backup time
  • Fast switching time ensures stable output during power failure
  • LED status indicators for easy monitoring
  • Overload & short-circuit protection
  • Quiet and efficient operation
  • Ideal for PCs, routers, DVRs/NVRs, office electronics, and home appliances
